verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only per-session programmatic retrieval of verification results, images, and extracted data through the API. That is a developer building block for constructing an export, not a documented bulk export of all data in open formats. Nothing in the pack describes a data-portability or account-exit export feature for Stripe Identity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
